description: Find approved public supplier storefronts and inspect reviewed credentials and platform-observed performance.

category.description: Supplier category to match against the reviewed catalog.

countryRegion.description: Exact country or region code/name used by the supplier profile.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous supplier search.

limit.description: Number of suppliers to return; server clamps this to 100.

minProducts.description: Minimum number of approved public SKUs in the supplier storefront.

q.description: Free-text search across public supplier name, legal name, description and slug.

supplierType.description: Supplier profile type, such as manufacturer, wholesaler or brand.

name: search_suppliers
